data.name: Zibraa
data.long_meaning: Zibraa is derived from the Arabic word 'zabr' which means 'to adorn', 'to decorate' or 'to embellish'. It implies a beautiful appearance.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the spiritual sense, it represents the inner beauty that comes with faith and submission to Allah.

in_arabic.name: زبراء
in_arabic.long_meaning: زبراء هي كلمة عربية تعني النصر والفوز والتمكن، وتأتي من الجذر زبر الذي يعني القوة والشدة، وقد ذكر هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان، وتستخدم هذه الكلمة في الثقافة الإسلامية للتعبير عن الانتصار والقوة

in_urdu.name: زبْراء
in_urdu.long_meaning: زبْراء ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے فتح و کامیابی اور قوت، اور یہ جڑ زبر سے اخذ ہوا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قوت اور شدت، اور اس جڑ کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں سورہ فرقان میں ہے، اور اس لفظ کا استعمال اسلامی ثقافت میں فتح اور قوت کے اظہار کے لیے ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: ज़िब्रा
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़िब्रा एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है विजय और शक्ति और सामर्थ्य, और यह जड़ ज़िब्र से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और तीव्रता, और इस जड़ का उल्लेख कुरआन मजीद में सूरह फुरकान में है, और इस शब्द का प्रयोग इस्लामी संस्कृति में विजय और शक्ति के प्रकटीकरण के लिए होता है

in_pashto.name: زبړې
in_pashto.long_meaning: زبړې د عربي کلمې ده چې معنی یې فتح او بری او قوت دی، او دا له جړ زبر څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې قوت او شدت دی، او د دې جړ ذکر قرآن کریم کې په سورې فرقان کې شوی دی، او د دې کلمې کارول د اسلامي فرهنګ کې د فتح او قوت ښودلو لپاره کیږي

in_english.name: Zibraa
in_english.long_meaning: Zibraa is an Arabic name that means victory and power and strength, and it comes from the root zibr which means strength and intensity, and this root is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Furqan, and this name is used in Islamic culture to express victory and strength

pronunciation.pashto: په زبړې کې د تلفظ طریقه

data.cultural_impact: The name Zibraa implies a sense of beauty and grace. In Muslim communities, the word 'zabr' is used to describe the adornment of mosques, houses, and people for religious occasions. As such, a person named Zibraa would be expected to embody this quality of beauty and decorum in their daily life and interactions with others.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Zibraa lies in the idea of adornment as a reflection of the divine beauty and love of Allah. In the Quran, Allah is described as the 'Lord of Majesty and Beauty' (Al-Majid), and as believers, we are encouraged to reflect His beautiful attributes in our own lives. A person named Zibraa may strive to embody this divine beauty by leading a righteous and virtuous life, engaging in acts of kindness and charity, and adorning themselves with the gifts of knowledge, wisdom, and good character.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Qutayba (d. 889 CE) in his book Al-Imamah wa'l-Siyasah (The Caliphate and Government) mentions a man named Zibraa ibn Abi Zuhayr.
historical_references.context: Ibn Qutayba was a prominent scholar and jurist of the Abbasid Caliphate. He mentions Zibraa in the context of a dispute between two prominent families of the time, the Barmakids and the Abbasids.
